drafted_from: workflow:find-what-your-pursuits-leave-out's row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (its input schema, steps and submit shapes)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:find-what-your-pursuits-leave-out about Your body: what do none of my pursuits do for it, and what have I already said I want there?"

lists.label: Your map
lists.holds: One area of the person's life, what it means and what it is part of.

values.means: How well your body is and what you do for it.
The objects, places and resources around you.
The people and animals in your life.

lists.label: Waiting on you
lists.holds: One thing only the person can finish, with why, how they finish it and what was tried first.

values.why: The market only accepts a form signed by the shop owner.
values.only_you_because: A signature is your own consent
values.tried: Filled in every other field from the shop facts; the signature line stayed empty.
values.done_when: The signed form is sent back

values.what: Tap to order 50 paper bakery boxes for 41.50
values.why: The plan says to bring boxes by Saturday.
values.tried: Found the store, built the order up to payment.

instructions: 1. Pour the example areas into the list where you keep the parts of your life (see pour), or make list:your-map from them; list:waiting-on-you holds only the rare area that needs you.
2. Say "Run workflow:find-what-your-pursuits-leave-out" (add about to look at one area).

3. The AI works read, look and keep: it finds the map areas none of your pursuits touch, searches your own words for each, and either puts an existing pursuit on the area or records the pursuit you already described with each quote.
4. Read what was kept and what was left on the map as missing; an area no evidence can decide becomes one row on your Waiting on you list.

worked_examples.title: The body is the one area no pursuit touches
worked_examples.ask: What do my pursuits leave out about my body?
worked_examples.given: The map list has the area body ("Your body"); the pursuits are pursuit:example-bakery (things, living) and pursuit:example-content (mind). With about set to Your body only that area is kept, and no pursuit touches it. Read from the read step of the workflow row.
worked_examples.hands_back: The submit shape of step read: {"missing":["body"],"pursuits":["pursuit:example-bakery","pursuit:example-content"]}

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
